tasks.label: Upload (ESP32 auto-port)
args: $port = (arduino-cli board list | Select-String 'ESP32S3' | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split '\s+')[0] }); arduino-cli upload --fqbn esp32:esp32:esp32s3:CDCOnBoot=cdc -p $port flix

tasks.label: Monitor (ESP32 auto-port)
args: $port = (arduino-cli board list | Select-String 'ESP32S3' | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split '\s+')[0] }); arduino-cli monitor -p $port -c baudrate=115200
